data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Resumption is permissible exactly when the event-framing protocol can deterministically identify the last complete committed event before the truncation point, quarantining any trailing partial bytes as non-events; it must be refused when framing is non-self-delimiting or when integrity checks reveal corruption within a nominally complete event.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The framing protocol provides no self-delimiting boundary or checksum, making the last-complete-event determination ambiguous.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"A nominally complete event's checksum fails, indicating intra-event corruption rather than clean truncation.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The causal fingerprint of the resumed stream diverges from the fingerprint an uninterrupted run would produce.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The append-only log has been tampered with between exhaustion and resumption, violating physical integrity independently of the truncation.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Under the two-level invariant decomposition (physical append-only integrity vs logical causal continuity), physical integrity is preserved by framing-quarantine: a partial byte sequence left by mid-stream exhaustion was never an event, so ignoring it violates no append-only commitment. Logical continuity is preserved by causal fingerprint matching: the resumed stream must produce the same observable sequence as an uninterrupted run would have past the last committed event. When the framing protocol uses self-delimiting records with checksums or end-markers, the boundary between committed events and orphaned fragments is deterministic, so quarantine is safe. When framing relies on length-prefixing alone without integrity checks, a truncated length field can cause the resumption protocol to misidentify a partial record as complete, corrupting logical continuity\u2014and so resumption must be refused until an out-of-band reconciliation establishes the true last-complete boundary.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
